alert: Loom step slots idle with work waiting

A.name: A
A.query:
WITH
  toInt64({{.end_timestamp_ms}}) AS end_ms,
  series AS (
    SELECT fingerprint,
           any(if(JSONExtractString(labels, 'host.name') != '', JSONExtractString(labels, 'host.name'), JSONExtractString(labels, 'host.id'))) AS host,
           any(lower(JSONExtractString(labels, 'repo'))) AS repo,
           any(JSONExtractString(labels, 'state')) AS state,
           any(JSONExtractString(labels, 'role')) AS role,
           any(JSONExtractString(labels, 'pool')) AS pool
    FROM signoz_metrics.time_series_v4
    WHERE metric_name IN ('loom.forge.stage_items', 'loom.dispatch.busy_slots', 'loom.dispatch.max_concurrent')
    GROUP BY fingerprint
  ),
  pts AS (
    SELECT series.host AS host, series.repo AS repo, series.state AS state,
           series.role AS role, series.pool AS pool,
           s.metric_name AS metric, s.unix_milli AS ms, s.value AS value
    FROM signoz_metrics.samples_v4 AS s
    INNER JOIN series USING (fingerprint)
    WHERE s.metric_name IN ('loom.forge.stage_items', 'loom.dispatch.busy_slots', 'loom.dispatch.max_concurrent')
      AND s.unix_milli >= {{.start_timestamp_ms}}
      AND s.unix_milli < {{.end_timestamp_ms}}
  ),
  host_repos AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT if(resources_string['host.name'] != '', resources_string['host.name'], resources_string['host.id']) AS host, lower(attributes_string['loom.repo']) AS repo
    FROM signoz_traces.signoz_index_v3
    WHERE name IN ('loom.dispatch.step', 'loom.dispatch.disposition')
      AND timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(end_ms - 86400000)
      AND timestamp < fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(end_ms)
      AND attributes_string['loom.repo'] != ''
  ),
  repo_depth_at AS (
    SELECT repo, ms, sum(value) AS depth
    FROM pts
    WHERE metric = 'loom.forge.stage_items' AND state IN ('triage', 'unlabeled', 'curated_not_promoted', 'issue_no_pr') AND repo != ''
    GROUP BY repo, ms
  ),
  repo_depth AS (
    SELECT repo, min(depth) AS min_depth, argMax(depth, ms) AS last_depth
    FROM repo_depth_at
    GROUP BY repo
  ),
  dispatching AS (
    SELECT host,
           maxIf(value, metric = 'loom.dispatch.busy_slots' AND role = 'sweep' AND pool = '') AS busy,
           maxIf(value, metric = 'loom.dispatch.max_concurrent') AS max_concurrent,
           minIf(ms, metric = 'loom.dispatch.max_concurrent') AS first_ms
    FROM pts
    WHERE host != '' AND metric != 'loom.forge.stage_items'
    GROUP BY host
  ),
  waiting AS (
    SELECT host_repos.host AS host,
           sum(repo_depth.last_depth) AS items,
           max(repo_depth.min_depth) AS min_depth
    FROM host_repos
    INNER JOIN repo_depth ON repo_depth.repo = host_repos.repo
    GROUP BY host
  )
SELECT toDateTime(intDiv(end_ms, 1000)) AS ts,
       dispatching.host AS host,
       dispatching.busy / dispatching.max_concurrent AS value
FROM dispatching
INNER JOIN waiting ON waiting.host = dispatching.host
WHERE dispatching.max_concurrent > 0
  AND waiting.min_depth > 0
  AND dispatching.first_ms <= {{.start_timestamp_ms}} + 300000
ORDER BY host

annotations.summary: Loom step slots idle with work waiting
annotations.description: Host {{$labels.host}} never filled half its slots in 30 min: its busiest loom.dispatch.busy_slots{role=sweep} reading was {{$value}} of loom.dispatch.max_concurrent, while at least one repo it dispatches for (by its loom.dispatch.step / loom.dispatch.disposition spans in the last 24 h) showed work waiting in every loom.forge.stage_items sample of the window (triage, unlabeled, curated_not_promoted, issue_no_pr). Look at pick.decision item_draw exclusions (cooling_down, pool_exhausted, build_backoff, claimed) and refused_* counts, and at loom.dispatch.step refusals. Issue rjwalters/loom#11909.
